description: Read-only SQL (SQLite) over tables saved with store_as: SELECT or WITH, plus SHOW TABLES and DESCRIBE <table>. Returns at most 200 rows; output_path writes the full result to a CSV file for bulk work. Nested fields are flattened with _ (trend.direction -> trend_direction); booleans are 1/0. Tables live in memory for this server process.

format.description: csv: rows as CSV text. Default json.

output_path.description: CSV file path for the full result (every row).

name: query_data
